versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the skill for WeChat Official Account explosive content detection.
- Supports trending article search with data-driven filtering based on low follower/high read, fast growth, and originality.
- Intelligent keyword detection, with discipline-specific recommendations and up to 10 high-quality results.
- Includes both Markdown and HTML grid card output formats.
- Manages broad (generic) vs. specific keywords, enforcing stepwise user interaction for abstract categories.
- Designed for content creators, editors, and MCNs to explore trending topics and data samples.
